mri_imaging.label: MRI Brain
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your brain to check for any abnormalities causing your symptoms

indications.label: Persistent unexplained headaches
indications.referral_text: MRI Brain — persistent headaches not responding to treatment, to exclude intracranial pathology.

indications.label: Dizziness with neurological signs
indications.referral_text: MRI Brain — dizziness with associated neurological signs to exclude central cause.

indications.label: Suspected cranial nerve pathology
indications.referral_text: MRI Brain — cranial nerve dysfunction to exclude compressive or inflammatory lesion.

indications.label: Progressive neurological deficit
indications.referral_text: MRI Brain — progressive upper motor neurone signs to exclude intracranial pathology.

mri_imaging.label: MRI TMJ
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your jaw joint to check the disc and surrounding structures

indications.label: Clicking with jaw locking
indications.referral_text: MRI TMJ — clicking and intermittent locking to assess disc position and integrity.

indications.label: Persistent limited jaw opening
indications.referral_text: MRI TMJ — restricted mouth opening not responding to conservative management.

indications.label: Suspected TMJ inflammatory arthropathy
indications.referral_text: MRI TMJ — persistent jaw pain and swelling to exclude inflammatory or degenerative joint disease.

indications.label: Preoperative surgical planning TMJ
indications.referral_text: MRI TMJ — failed conservative management, surgical opinion sought, imaging to define disc and joint status.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Cervical Spine
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your neck to check the discs, nerves and spinal cord

indications.label: Radiculopathy not resolving conservatively
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine — persistent arm pain in a dermatomal pattern with neurological deficit, not improving with physiotherapy.

indications.label: Suspected cervical myelopathy signs
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine — upper motor neurone signs in the limbs suggesting possible cervical cord compression.

indications.label: Neck pain post significant trauma
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine — persistent neck pain following significant trauma to exclude ligamentous or disc injury.

indications.label: Progressive bilateral arm symptoms
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine — bilateral upper limb paraesthesia and weakness to exclude central cord pathology.

indications.label: Suspected cervical cord compression
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine — acute gait disturbance with upper motor neurone signs suggestive of cord compression.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Cervical Spine with Contrast
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your neck using contrast dye to check for infection, inflammation or tumour

indications.label: Suspected spinal infection cervical
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine with contrast — neck pain with fever and raised inflammatory markers to exclude discitis or epidural abscess.

indications.label: Suspected cervical spinal tumour
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine with contrast — progressive neurological deficit with night pain and weight loss to exclude neoplastic cause.

indications.label: Post-surgical cervical spine assessment
indications.referral_text: MRI Cervical Spine with contrast — recurrent symptoms post cervical surgery to differentiate scar tissue from recurrent disc herniation.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Thoracic Spine
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your mid-back to check the discs, spinal cord and vertebrae

indications.label: Thoracic pain with red flags
indications.referral_text: MRI Thoracic Spine — thoracic pain with history of malignancy or unexplained weight loss to exclude spinal metastasis.

indications.label: Suspected thoracic cord compression
indications.referral_text: MRI Thoracic Spine — progressive lower limb weakness with sensory level and gait disturbance to exclude thoracic cord compression.

indications.label: Thoracic radiculopathy band-like pain
indications.referral_text: MRI Thoracic Spine — persistent dermatomal chest or abdominal wall pain to assess for thoracic disc pathology or nerve root compression.

indications.label: Suspected thoracic compression fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Thoracic Spine — acute onset thoracic pain in an osteoporotic patient to confirm vertebral compression fracture acuity.

indications.label: Demyelinating disease assessment thoracic
indications.referral_text: MRI Thoracic Spine — known or suspected demyelinating disease with new lower limb symptoms.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Lumbar Spine
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your lower back to check the discs, nerves and vertebrae

indications.label: Sciatica not improving conservatively
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine — persistent radicular leg pain beyond six weeks not responding to physiotherapy, to identify compressive pathology.

indications.label: Suspected cauda equina syndrome
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine — saddle anaesthesia, bladder dysfunction or rapidly progressive bilateral leg weakness suggesting cauda equina syndrome.

indications.label: Neurogenic claudication suspected stenosis
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine — bilateral leg symptoms on walking relieved by sitting and flexion, suspected lumbar canal stenosis.

indications.label: Progressive neurological deficit leg
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine — progressive lower limb motor weakness in a myotomal distribution requiring urgent assessment.

indications.label: Low back pain with red flags
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine — low back pain with red flags including night pain, weight loss or history of malignancy.

indications.label: Spondylolisthesis with neurological symptoms
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine — known spondylolisthesis with new or worsening radicular symptoms to assess nerve root involvement.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Lumbar Spine with Contrast
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your lower back using contrast dye to check for infection, tumour or post-surgical changes

indications.label: Suspected lumbar spinal infection
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine with contrast — severe back pain with fever and raised inflammatory markers to exclude discitis or epidural abscess.

indications.label: Post-surgical recurrent lumbar symptoms
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine with contrast — recurrent radiculopathy post lumbar surgery to differentiate scar from recurrent disc herniation.

indications.label: Suspected spinal tumour lumbar
indications.referral_text: MRI Lumbar Spine with contrast — persistent back pain with nocturnal symptoms and constitutional signs to exclude neoplasm.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Sacrum
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of the triangular bone at the base of your spine

indications.label: Suspected sacral stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacrum — localised sacral pain in a runner or osteoporotic patient to confirm or exclude sacral stress fracture.

indications.label: Coccydynia not responding treatment
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacrum — persistent coccyx pain despite conservative management to exclude fracture or underlying pathology.

indications.label: Suspected sacral tumour
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacrum — unexplained sacral pain with neurological symptoms and constitutional signs to exclude sacral tumour.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Sacroiliac Joints
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of the joints between your lower spine and pelvis to check for inflammation

indications.label: Suspected inflammatory sacroiliitis
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacroiliac Joints — buttock pain with inflammatory pattern and morning stiffness in a young adult to assess for sacroiliitis.

indications.label: Suspected axial spondyloarthropathy
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacroiliac Joints — chronic low back pain with inflammatory features, raised HLA-B27, to support diagnosis of axial spondyloarthropathy.

indications.label: SIJ pain post-partum persistent
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacroiliac Joints — persistent post-partum sacroiliac pain beyond six months to assess joint integrity and exclude stress injury.

indications.label: Suspected SIJ infection
indications.referral_text: MRI Sacroiliac Joints — unilateral SIJ pain with fever and raised inflammatory markers to exclude septic arthritis.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Ribs / Chest Wall
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your ribs and chest wall to check for injury or other problems

indications.label: Suspected rib stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Ribs — localised rib pain in an athlete with negative X-ray to confirm or exclude stress fracture.

indications.label: Chest wall mass palpable
indications.referral_text: MRI Ribs — palpable chest wall mass to characterise soft tissue or bony lesion.

indications.label: Persistent rib pain post trauma
indications.referral_text: MRI Ribs — ongoing rib pain after trauma with negative X-ray to assess for occult fracture or costochondral injury.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Pelvis
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your pelvic bones and surrounding muscles

indications.label: Suspected pelvic stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Pelvis — activity-related pelvic pain in a distance runner or osteoporotic patient to exclude stress fracture.

indications.label: Athletic groin pain complex
indications.referral_text: MRI Pelvis — chronic groin pain in an athlete to assess pubic symphysis, adductor insertions and surrounding structures.

indications.label: Suspected avulsion injury pelvis
indications.referral_text: MRI Pelvis — acute onset pain at a bony prominence in an adolescent athlete to confirm avulsion injury.

indications.label: Pelvic pain suspected bony pathology
indications.referral_text: MRI Pelvis — persistent unexplained pelvic bone pain to exclude tumour or occult fracture.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Shoulder
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your shoulder to check the tendons, labrum and joint

indications.label: Suspected rotator cuff tear
indications.referral_text: MRI Shoulder — persistent shoulder weakness and pain not responding to rehabilitation, suspected rotator cuff tear.

indications.label: Recurrent shoulder instability assessment
indications.referral_text: MRI Shoulder — recurrent shoulder dislocations or subluxations to assess labral and capsular integrity.

indications.label: Acute traumatic rotator cuff injury
indications.referral_text: MRI Shoulder — acute inability to raise arm following a fall or trauma in a patient over 40, suspected acute rotator cuff tear.

indications.label: Shoulder pain suspect labral pathology
indications.referral_text: MRI Shoulder — deep shoulder pain with clicking, positive labral tests, to assess for SLAP or labral tear.

indications.label: Frozen shoulder atypical features
indications.referral_text: MRI Shoulder — restricted shoulder with atypical features or failure to progress to exclude underlying structural pathology.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Upper Arm / Humerus
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your upper arm to check the bone, muscles and tendons

indications.label: Suspected humeral stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Upper Arm — localised humeral shaft pain in a throwing athlete or military recruit to exclude stress fracture.

indications.label: Soft tissue mass upper arm
indications.referral_text: MRI Upper Arm — palpable mass in the upper arm to characterise soft tissue lesion.

indications.label: Suspected biceps or triceps tear
indications.referral_text: MRI Upper Arm — acute pain and deformity after forceful contraction to confirm proximal biceps or triceps tendon rupture.

indications.label: Unexplained upper arm bone pain
indications.referral_text: MRI Upper Arm — persistent unexplained bone pain in the humerus to exclude tumour or occult pathology.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Elbow
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your elbow to check the ligaments, tendons and joint

indications.label: Chronic lateral elbow pain refractory
indications.referral_text: MRI Elbow — lateral epicondylalgia not responding to six months of physiotherapy to assess tendon integrity and exclude intra-articular pathology.

indications.label: Suspected UCL injury throwing athlete
indications.referral_text: MRI Elbow — medial elbow pain in a throwing athlete with valgus instability to assess ulnar collateral ligament.

indications.label: Locking elbow suspected loose body
indications.referral_text: MRI Elbow — mechanical locking and catching of the elbow to identify intra-articular loose body.

indications.label: Distal biceps tendon injury suspected
indications.referral_text: MRI Elbow — acute anterior elbow pain and weakness of supination following forceful lifting to assess distal biceps tendon.

indications.label: Ulnar nerve symptoms at elbow
indications.referral_text: MRI Elbow — persistent medial elbow pain with ring and little finger paraesthesia to assess cubital tunnel and ulnar nerve.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Forearm
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your forearm to check the bones, muscles and tendons

indications.label: Suspected forearm stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Forearm — localised forearm pain in a gymnast or racquet sport athlete with negative X-ray to exclude stress fracture.

indications.label: Forearm compartment syndrome chronic
indications.referral_text: MRI Forearm — exertional forearm pain and tightness in a climber or motorcyclist to assess for chronic exertional compartment syndrome.

indications.label: Soft tissue mass forearm
indications.referral_text: MRI Forearm — palpable forearm mass to characterise lesion and plan management.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Wrist
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your wrist to check the small bones, ligaments and tendons

indications.label: Suspected scaphoid fracture occult
indications.referral_text: MRI Wrist — clinical suspicion of scaphoid fracture with negative initial X-rays to confirm or exclude fracture.

indications.label: Scaphoid avascular necrosis suspected
indications.referral_text: MRI Wrist — previous scaphoid fracture with ongoing pain to assess for avascular necrosis.

indications.label: Chronic ulnar-sided wrist pain
indications.referral_text: MRI Wrist — persistent ulnar-sided wrist pain to assess TFCC and ulnocarpal structures.

indications.label: Suspected carpal ligament instability
indications.referral_text: MRI Wrist — wrist pain with clicking and weakness following a fall to assess scapholunate and intrinsic ligament integrity.

indications.label: Suspected Kienböck disease
indications.referral_text: MRI Wrist — progressive dorsal wrist pain with reduced grip strength to assess lunate vascularity.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Hand
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your hand to check the small bones, joints and soft tissues

indications.label: Suspected inflammatory arthritis hands
indications.referral_text: MRI Hand — symmetrical small joint pain and swelling with raised inflammatory markers to assess for early inflammatory arthropathy.

indications.label: Suspected finger pulley injury
indications.referral_text: MRI Hand — acute finger pain in a rock climber with bowstringing to confirm pulley rupture.

indications.label: Occult metacarpal or phalangeal fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Hand — persistent post-traumatic hand pain with negative X-ray to exclude occult fracture.

indications.label: Soft tissue mass hand
indications.referral_text: MRI Hand — palpable hand mass to characterise lesion and plan further management.
finds: giant cell tumour of tendon sheath

mri_imaging.label: MRI Hip
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your hip joint to check the bone, cartilage, labrum and tendons

indications.label: Suspected labral tear hip
indications.referral_text: MRI Hip — deep groin pain with clicking and positive impingement tests to assess labrum and joint.

indications.label: Suspected femoral neck stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Hip — activity-related groin pain in a runner or military recruit with positive hop test to exclude femoral neck stress fracture.

indications.label: Suspected avascular necrosis femoral head
indications.referral_text: MRI Hip — progressive hip pain with risk factors for AVN to assess femoral head vascularity.

indications.label: Hip pain in child limping
indications.referral_text: MRI Hip — atraumatic limp and hip pain in a child to exclude Perthes disease, SUFE or transient synovitis.

indications.label: Gluteal tendinopathy refractory to treatment
indications.referral_text: MRI Hip — persistent lateral hip pain not responding to exercise rehabilitation to assess gluteal tendons and trochanteric bursa.

indications.label: Suspected occult hip fracture elderly
indications.referral_text: MRI Hip — unable to weight-bear after a fall with negative X-ray in an elderly patient to exclude occult hip fracture.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Thigh
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your thigh to check the muscles, tendons and bone

indications.label: Hamstring tear grading return to sport
indications.referral_text: MRI Thigh — acute hamstring injury in a competitive athlete to grade tear and guide return-to-sport timeline.

indications.label: Proximal hamstring tendon avulsion
indications.referral_text: MRI Thigh — acute severe posterior thigh pain with bruising extending to the knee, suspected proximal hamstring avulsion.

indications.label: Quadriceps injury assessment athlete
indications.referral_text: MRI Thigh — acute anterior thigh pain after sprinting to assess rectus femoris and quadriceps integrity.

indications.label: Thigh mass or swelling unexplained
indications.referral_text: MRI Thigh — palpable or enlarging thigh mass to characterise soft tissue lesion.

indications.label: Suspected femoral shaft stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Thigh — progressive activity-related thigh pain in an endurance athlete with negative X-ray to exclude femoral stress fracture.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Knee
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your knee to check the ligaments, cartilage and meniscus

indications.label: Suspected ACL tear
indications.referral_text: MRI Knee — suspected ACL tear with giving way and positive Lachman test following a twisting injury.

indications.label: Suspected meniscal tear locking
indications.referral_text: MRI Knee — mechanical locking and joint line tenderness suggestive of meniscal tear.

indications.label: Multi-ligament knee injury
indications.referral_text: MRI Knee — acute knee dislocation or multi-directional instability to assess all ligament and neurovascular structures.

indications.label: Persistent knee effusion investigation
indications.referral_text: MRI Knee — recurrent or persistent knee effusion not explained by clinical findings to exclude intra-articular pathology.

indications.label: Suspected osteochondral defect knee
indications.referral_text: MRI Knee — localised knee pain with catching, suspected osteochondral lesion or osteochondritis dissecans.

indications.label: Patellofemoral pain refractory assessment
indications.referral_text: MRI Knee — persistent anterior knee pain with suspected patellar cartilage damage or instability not responding to rehabilitation.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Lower Leg / Tibia
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your shin and calf to check the bones, muscles and tendons

indications.label: Suspected tibial stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Lower Leg — localised tibial pain with hopping pain in a runner to confirm or exclude stress fracture.

indications.label: Achilles tendon rupture assessment
indications.referral_text: MRI Lower Leg — acute calf pain with positive Thompson test and palpable gap to confirm Achilles tendon rupture and measure gap.

indications.label: Chronic Achilles tendinopathy refractory
indications.referral_text: MRI Lower Leg — persistent Achilles tendon pain beyond three months of rehabilitation to assess tendon structure.

indications.label: Calf muscle tear grading
indications.referral_text: MRI Lower Leg — significant calf muscle injury in an athlete to grade tear and plan rehabilitation.

indications.label: Chronic exertional compartment syndrome
indications.referral_text: MRI Lower Leg — exertional lower leg pain and tightness reproducible with exercise to assess for chronic exertional compartment syndrome.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Ankle
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your ankle to check the ligaments, tendons and joint

indications.label: Chronic ankle instability assessment
indications.referral_text: MRI Ankle — recurrent ankle sprains with persistent instability to assess ligament integrity and osteochondral status.

indications.label: Suspected osteochondral lesion talus
indications.referral_text: MRI Ankle — persistent deep ankle pain after inversion injury to assess for osteochondral lesion of the talus.

indications.label: Posterior ankle impingement suspected
indications.referral_text: MRI Ankle — posterior ankle pain on plantarflexion in a dancer or footballer to assess for posterior impingement.

indications.label: Peroneal tendon pathology suspected
indications.referral_text: MRI Ankle — lateral ankle pain with peroneal weakness and swelling to assess peroneal tendon integrity.

indications.label: Anterior ankle impingement persistent
indications.referral_text: MRI Ankle — anterior ankle pain with restricted dorsiflexion and anterior joint line tenderness to assess for impingement.

indications.label: Suspected syndesmosis injury high ankle
indications.referral_text: MRI Ankle — high ankle sprain with positive squeeze and external rotation tests to assess syndesmosis integrity.

mri_imaging.label: MRI Foot
mri_imaging.patient_label: A scan of your foot to check the bones, joints and soft tissues

indications.label: Suspected metatarsal stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Foot — localised metatarsal pain in an athlete or military recruit with negative X-ray to exclude stress fracture.

indications.label: Suspected navicular stress fracture
indications.referral_text: MRI Foot — midfoot pain aggravated by push-off in an athletic patient to exclude navicular stress fracture.

indications.label: Plantar fasciitis refractory to treatment
indications.referral_text: MRI Foot — persistent plantar heel pain beyond six months of conservative care to assess plantar fascia and exclude other pathology.

indications.label: Suspected Morton neuroma or metatarsalgia
indications.referral_text: MRI Foot — interdigital pain with positive Mulder click to confirm Morton neuroma or intermetatarsal bursitis.

indications.label: Suspected Lisfranc injury
indications.referral_text: MRI Foot — midfoot pain and swelling after twisting injury with inability to bear weight to assess Lisfranc ligament complex.

indications.label: Posterior tibial tendon dysfunction
indications.referral_text: MRI Foot — progressive flat foot deformity with medial ankle and arch pain to assess posterior tibial tendon.
